verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

evidence: [F] 97% of late trains were already late at 7 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 18 Av: 131, at Church Av: 6, on approach from 7 Av: 4, at 15 St-Prospect Park: 3.

[G] 79% of late trains were already late leaving Church Av: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
Weekend problem rate is 1.6x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
40% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 1.3x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 36% of delays on line(s) F, G (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
51% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 84%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 226s on average vs 95s otherwise (2.4x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
8% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'track' alert was active for the line (problem rate 45% with an alert vs 24% without, lift 1.9x).

MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 16% of delays on line(s) F, G (0.7x the system share) in the analysed months.
